crossRefs.note: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
Yahweh, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a…
Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it…
Who has believed our message? To whom has Yahweh’s arm been revealed?
and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.
“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered…
The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who…
Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give…
All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life…
Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and…
He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
The testimony is this, that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

translations.web: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
translations.bsb: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
translations.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
translations.asv: and ye will not come to me, that ye may have life.
